title: Section realization of the restricted scalar computation counit
statement: Let Λ and Λ′ be commutative condensed rings, a : Λ → Λ′ a morphism, and T a scheme. Let s : SectionScalarComparison a T satisfy SectionScalarNormalized a T s from [def-sfb-internal-section-scalar-pullback-comparison-data]. Let t : TensorNormalization a T be the ordinary and derived internal tensor data of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]; no TensorNormalized assumption is made. Let o be an ordinary section scalar extension/restriction to right-tensor isomorphism satisfying the generator equation of [def-sfb-section-scalar-tensor-normalization-data]. For an internal cochain complex P whose termwise section image is K-flat with flat terms, transport the internal scalar counit compute through exact restriction V and its localization factor, then apply Q of the ordinary tensor map t.ordinary and the right-tensor section localization of [lem-sfb-section-tensor-right-computation]. This equals the section restriction comparison on D(QP), followed by the restricted s.derived, restricted derived scalar image of αP, restricted section scalar computation counit on EP, exact section restriction localization, and Q of the ordinary complex comparison induced by o. This compares only scalar counits and ordinary tensor maps: there is no section derived tensor isomorphism e and no internal derived normalization hypothesis.

source.place: Paragraph (1), scalar reduction comparison; extracted tensor/scalar part of lem-sfb-section-tensor-conjugate-computation step 1. Stacks sites-modules.tex section-tensor-product (03EK); sites-cohomology.tex definition-K-flat and lemma-derived-base-change (06YN, 06YY), and lemma-adjoint (07A6).

proof.text: Compare the ordinary maps on internal scalar-extension generators using the ordinary clauses of hs, the prescribed generator formula of o, the balancing/symmetry formula for t.ordinary and the fixed ordinary tensor comparison. Cancel the epimorphic scalar-extension projection and use tensor induction and sheafification to obtain equality of maps. Apply this in every degree to obtain the corresponding chain square.

Expand the exact restriction section comparison using composition and natural-isomorphism localization factors. Their factor equations identify it with the termwise restriction square. Move the ordinary scalar comparison through exact restriction by naturality of its localization factor. Substitute the K-flat computation clause of SectionScalarNormalized. Functoriality gives exactly the asserted restricted scalar counit equation.

theorem section_scalar_computation_transport (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (s : SectionScalarComparison a T)
    (hs : SectionScalarNormalized a T s) (t : TensorNormalization a T)
    (o : s.pair.extension ⋙ SheafOfModules.scalarRestriction.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (sectionScalarMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (coefficientMap a T)) ≅
        tensorRight ((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ T).functor.obj (B₀ a T)))
    (ho : (∀ (M : ModuleRingedComparison.modules Λ T) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (z : (ModuleRingedComparison.ring Λ' T).obj.obj U) (x : M.val.obj U),
    (o.hom.app M).val.app U
      ((eqToHom (s.pair.extension_obj M).symm).val.app U
        ((toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
          (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf
            (sectionScalarMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
              (coefficientMap a T)) M).presheaf).app U
              (z ⊗ₜ[(ModuleRingedComparison.ring Λ T).obj.obj U,((sectionScalarMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
                  (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (coefficientMap a T)).hom.app U).hom] x))) =
      ModuleRingedComparison.sectionPureTensor Λ T M
        ((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ T).functor.obj (B₀ a T)) U x z))
    (P : CochainComplex (Modules Λ T) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := ModuleRingedComparison.ring Λ T)
      (((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ T).functor.mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (hflat : ∀ n : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
      (R := ModuleRingedComparison.ring Λ T)
      ((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ T).functor.obj (P.X n))) :
    (ModuleRingedComparison.derivedEquivalence Λ T).functor.map
      ((V a T).map (compute a T P) ≫
        (V₀ a T).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          (((extension a T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso t.ordinary (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)) ≫
        (sectionTensorRightLocalization a T P).hom =
      (sectionScalarRestriction a T s).hom.app ((D a T).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
        (SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
          (sectionScalarMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (coefficientMap a T))).map
            (s.derived.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
        (SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
          (sectionScalarMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (coefficientMap a T))).map
            (s.pair.derived.map
              (ModuleRingedComparison.sectionLocalizationComparison Λ T P).hom) ≫
        (SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
          (sectionScalarMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (coefficientMap a T))).map
            (SheafOfModules.scalarPairComplexComparison.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
              s.pair.extension s.pair.extension_additive s.pair.derived s.pair.counit
              (((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ T).functor.mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫
        (SheafOfModules.scalarRestrictionComparison.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
          (sectionScalarMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
            (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (coefficientMap a T))).hom.app
            ((SheafOfModules.scalarComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
              s.pair.extension s.pair.extension_additive).obj
              (((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ T).functor.mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso o (.up ℤ)).hom.app
          (((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ T).functor.mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj P))
